# ARGON Web & App Design Vault

> AI-ready web & mobile UI design intelligence library (1370 components, 10 categories) with OKLCH tokens, motion specs, React/Tailwind & Flutter implementations.

## Core Entry Points
- [Vault Home](https://emirkankirman2-arch.github.io/web-app-design-vault/) | [Raw index.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/emirkankirman2-arch/web-app-design-vault/main/index.md): Main UI category & showcase directory
- [Project README](https://emirkankirman2-arch.github.io/web-app-design-vault/README) | [Raw README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/emirkankirman2-arch/web-app-design-vault/main/README.md): Overview, Mermaid pipeline & MCP guide
- [Full Plain-Text Showcase](https://emirkankirman2-arch.github.io/web-app-design-vault/llms-full.txt) | [Raw](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/emirkankirman2-arch/web-app-design-vault/main/llms-full.txt): Single-file LLM dump
- [Discovery JSON](https://emirkankirman2-arch.github.io/web-app-design-vault/discover.json) | [Raw](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/emirkankirman2-arch/web-app-design-vault/main/discover.json): Machine-readable UI index

## AI Agent Quickstart & MCP Examples
1. Read `discover.json` for category counts, component IDs, and raw Markdown URLs.
2. Supporter Pack `argon_vault_mcp.py` exposes `search_components`, `get_category_components`, `get_design_tokens`, and `get_motion_specs`.

## 10 UI Component Categories
- [Card (394)](https://emirkankirman2-arch.github.io/web-app-design-vault/categories/01_Card) | [Raw](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/emirkankirman2-arch/web-app-design-vault/main/categories/01_Card.md): Modular surface containers, glass/elevated cards, hover elevation & hierarchy
- [Button (300)](https://emirkankirman2-arch.github.io/web-app-design-vault/categories/02_Button) | [Raw](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/emirkankirman2-arch/web-app-design-vault/main/categories/02_Button.md): Primary/secondary CTAs, tactile press micro-interactions, states & glow borders
- [GlassMenu (157)](https://emirkankirman2-arch.github.io/web-app-design-vault/categories/03_GlassMenu) | [Raw](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/emirkankirman2-arch/web-app-design-vault/main/categories/03_GlassMenu.md): Frosted glass navigation menus, backdrop-filter blur, multi-tab transitions
- [Navbar (156)](https://emirkankirman2-arch.github.io/web-app-design-vault/categories/04_Navbar) | [Raw](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/emirkankirman2-arch/web-app-design-vault/main/categories/04_Navbar.md): Responsive top/floating headers, sticky scroll morphing & active pill indicators
- [Hero (136)](https://emirkankirman2-arch.github.io/web-app-design-vault/categories/05_Hero) | [Raw](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/emirkankirman2-arch/web-app-design-vault/main/categories/05_Hero.md): Above-the-fold compositions, kinetic typography, gradient spotlights & depth layers
- [Input (97)](https://emirkankirman2-arch.github.io/web-app-design-vault/categories/06_Input) | [Raw](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/emirkankirman2-arch/web-app-design-vault/main/categories/06_Input.md): Floating labels, validation transitions, search bars & focus rings
- [LockScreen (68)](https://emirkankirman2-arch.github.io/web-app-design-vault/categories/07_LockScreen) | [Raw](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/emirkankirman2-arch/web-app-design-vault/main/categories/07_LockScreen.md): Mobile unlock states, biometric pulse animations, blurred clock & notification stacks
- [Modal (54)](https://emirkankirman2-arch.github.io/web-app-design-vault/categories/08_Modal) | [Raw](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/emirkankirman2-arch/web-app-design-vault/main/categories/08_Modal.md): Dialog overlays, command palettes, backdrop dimming & spring scale entrance
- [SplashAuth (5)](https://emirkankirman2-arch.github.io/web-app-design-vault/categories/09_SplashAuth) | [Raw](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/emirkankirman2-arch/web-app-design-vault/main/categories/09_SplashAuth.md): Onboarding splash screens, OAuth auth flows, brand reveal & skeleton states
- [ShaderCanvas (3)](https://emirkankirman2-arch.github.io/web-app-design-vault/categories/10_ShaderCanvas) | [Raw](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/emirkankirman2-arch/web-app-design-vault/main/categories/10_ShaderCanvas.md): WebGL/CSS noise shaders, mesh gradients, interactive glow & particle canvases
